statements.status_notes: Alias of CVE-2026-57585. pip vendors msgpack 1.1.2 without the vulnerable _cmsgpack C extension; only the pure-Python fallback is present under pip/_vendor/msgpack.

pip's vendored msgpack is the pure-Python fallback only (fallback.py, ext.py, exceptions.py). CVE-2026-57585 is a use-after-free in the Cython _cmsgpack extension; pip does not ship that native module and always falls back to the pure-Python implementation.

Same pip vendor BOM artifact as CVE-2025-47273. The MANIFEST.in Unicode-normalization sdist exclusion bug is in setuptools' sdist build path; pip does not ship that code—only a pkg_resources subset for importlib metadata.

Scanners report setuptools@70.3.0 when pip 26.2's CycloneDX vendor BOM is ingested. DHI python3-pip ships the upstream pip wheel unchanged: pip vendors only a stripped pkg_resources tree derived from setuptools 70.3.0 and does not ship setuptools/package_index.py where this path-traversal flaw lives.

CVE-2026-56392 is an integer overflow in unexpand buffer allocation that multiplies max_column_width by MB_LEN_MAX. That allocation path was introduced after coreutils 9.7 (multibyte expand/unexpand support; first present in 9.11). Debian trixie and this DHI package ship 9.7, which still allocates with ximalloc(max_column_width) and does not contain the vulnerable multiply.
The DHI coreutils package backports the upstream uniq -w multibyte find_field() fix from commit d64e35a8a4c0e4608321433e0d84d917e4e36371.

underscore is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/underscore/. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI served under /tree; the default user-facing UI shipped by this image is JupyterLab 4.x (served under /lab) which does not load this bundled underscore. The vulnerable code runs in the user's browser only if they actively navigate to the classic UI, and only with input the user themselves controls (their own notebook content). No server-side code path imports or executes this bundled JavaScript.

react 16.0.0 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/react/. nbclassic is the legacy Jupyter Notebook compatibility shim; the default UI shipped by this image is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own (newer) react and does not load nbclassic's bundled copy. The renderToStaticMarkup XSS path runs in the user's browser only if the user opts into the classic /tree UI, and only with notebook content the user themselves authored or chose to open.

mathjax 2.7.9 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/MathJax/. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI; the default user-facing UI in this image is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own (newer) MathJax bundle, not the bundled-with-nbclassic copy. The vulnerable ReDoS regex runs in the user's browser only if the user opts into the classic UI under /tree, and only with input the user themselves controls (math expressions in their own notebook). Upstream Mathjax 2.x is in long-term maintenance and no fix is planned in that line.
